final_topology.title: Hierarchical Network Architecture
final_topology.description: A secure hierarchical network with an Internet Edge, a three-tier data center, and WAN connections to remote sites.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes an Internet Edge with a firewall and application-layer security, a three-tier data center, and WAN links to a regional and branch office with local routing and switching.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Management System' (n_new1) that tracks assets across various zones, including servers, routers, switches, and endpoints.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n_new2) that documents data flows between various nodes and zones.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Sensitive Data Zone' (z_preserve2) and a 'Non-Production Zone' (z7), indicating that data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes 'Server Firewalls' (n_new3 and n_new4) protecting servers in the Data Center and Non-Production Zone.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n15) in the Internet Edge zone, and there are links indicating DNS requests from the firewall (n1) to the DNS server.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' (n10) and links indicating integration with the 'Identity Server' (n13) for AAA, which typically includes MFA.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' (n_new5) with links to the firewall (n1) and DNS server (n15).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'URL Filtering Service' (n_new6) with links to the firewall (n1) and remote access VPN gateway (n10).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (Internet Edge, Data Center, Regional Office, Branch Office, Management Zone, Non-Production Zone) and links indicating proper segmentation and least privilege.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IaC Management Management Service' (n_struct6) in the IaC Management zone, indicating the use of version-controlled Infrastructure-as-Code.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Identity Server' (n13) in the Management Zone, and links indicating integration with the firewall (n1) and remote access VPN gateway (n10).

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' (n10) and links indicating integration with the 'Identity Server' (n13) for AAA.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Admin Workstation' (n18) in the Management Zone, which is segmented from other zones and does not have internet access.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' (n12) and 'NIDS' (n19) in the Internet Edge zone, indicating the deployment of network intrusion detection solutions.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes firewalls (n1, n_new3, n_new4) and links indicating traffic filtering between different zones (e.g., Internet Edge to WAN, Data Center to Non-Production Zone).

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Remote Access VPN Gateway' (n10) and links indicating integration with the 'Identity Server' (n13) for AAA, which typically includes access control checks.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'SIEM' (n14) in the Management Zone, and links indicating flow logs from the firewall (n1) to the SIEM.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'NIPS' (n20) in the Internet Edge zone, indicating the deployment of a network intrusion prevention solution.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes an '802.1X Controller' (n22) in the Internet Edge zone, indicating the deployment of port-level access control.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Application Layer Security Appliance' (n2) and 'Application Firewall' (n21) in the Internet Edge zone, indicating the deployment of application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Center' (z2) and a 'Non-Production Zone' (z7), indicating the separation of production and non-production systems.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Pen Testing Security Gateway' (n_struct7) and 'Pen Testing Service' (n_new7) in the Pen Testing zone, indicating the capability to perform external penetration tests.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z7 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes to indicate asset tracking.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes data flow links, but there is no explicit evidence of documented data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit documentation of data flows is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant data flow links.

findings_before.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not show firewalls implemented on any servers.
findings_before.missing_reason: No firewalls are shown on servers.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add firewall nodes to server zones and link them to the servers.

findings_before.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not show any DNS filtering services.
findings_before.missing_reason: No DNS filtering services are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a DNS filtering service and link it to the DNS server and other relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
findings_before.evidence: The topology does not show any network-based URL filters.
findings_before.missing_reason: No network-based URL filters are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a URL filtering service and link it to the firewall and other relevant nodes.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a Pen Testing Security Gateway (n_struct7) in the Pen Testing zone (z11), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to the Pen Testing Security Gateway and other relevant nodes.
